request.what: Fund Dolos by TxPipe for Year 2 maintenance of Cardano's lightweight data node, submitted by Intersect on behalf of the vendor.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve, with a budget summary totaling 540,750 ADA including a 15,750 ADA Intersect administration fee.
Dolos is described as a lightweight Cardano data node built in Rust that provides efficient access to chain data without the overhead of traditional full nodes.
Dolos exposes five query interfaces, including Mini-Blockfrost HTTP, UTxO-RPC gRPC, Mini-Kupo, and an Ouroboros Node-to-Client Unix socket compatible with Cardano-cli, Ogmios, and other tooling.
The document states Dolos has 939 commits, 80 releases, 129 stars, 51 forks, and 27 contributors.

The maintainer scope covers dependency updates, protocol compatibility, performance improvements, bug fixes, documentation, issue triage, review of external contributions, ecosystem-driven enhancements, public communication, and AI-friendly documentation and integration resources.
The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The proposal states the requested amount does not, at submission, individually or in aggregate breach the 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
The document states TxPipe has received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals from Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 under development and on schedule.
The document states TxPipe received 2025 Intersect open-source maintenance funding for Pallas, Dolos, and UTxO RPC and that all are being delivered on schedule.

Intersect will use Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with specified reserve and project-specific addresses, multi-party authorization requirements, external oversight entities, milestone-based disbursement controls, and a public dashboard for auditability.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA for a 12-month Dolos maintenance grant administered through Intersect treasury management contracts, with claims about Dolos technical utility, open-source activity, Intersect budget-process approval, NCL compliance, prior TxPipe delivery, and oversight controls.
